issues.display_title: Issue #150: fix(db): default DB_DRIVER to postgres and drop the fictional MySQL path
issues.main_description_html:
InitDB defaults DB_DRIVER to mysql when the env var is unset (src/config/database.go:93-95). Everything else in the repo assumes Postgres:

  • cmd/migrate/main.go:63-65 refuses to run migrations unless DB_DRIVER=postgres.
  • Every file in migrations/ is Postgres DDL — UUID, TIMESTAMPTZ, public. schema.
  • .env.example:3 already says DB_DRIVER=postgres.

So the only thing keeping production on Postgres is that env var being present. If it ever goes missing the app silently falls back to a MySQL DSN — and on MySQL, CanvasData string gorm:"type:text"`` (src/models/models.go:67) is a 64 KB column. The frontend now saves canvas blobs of ~1.7 MB for a multi-floor import (GoThruMedia/gothru-3d-floormap#626), so that fallback would truncate or reject every save.

Scope

  • Default to postgres when DB_DRIVER is unset, in InitDB and in buildDSN.
  • Remove the MySQL dialector and DSN branch. It cannot work: the schema is Postgres-only DDL and the migration runner rejects the driver. Keeping it is a trap, not a feature.
  • An unrecognised DB_DRIVER fails at startup with a clear message instead of guessing.
  • README: state that Postgres is the default and the only supported driver.

Acceptance

  • DB_DRIVER unset → Postgres DSN, Postgres dialector
  • DB_DRIVER=mysql (or anything else) → startup error naming the driver
  • go test ./... green
